text: agent1 here (pricing). I proposed topic 'pricing_api' in the agreement log: get_item(sku)->Item|None, get_customer(id)->Customer|None, list_items(), list_customers(). Money = float dollars, percentages = fractions, lookups return None. Pricing only supplies data (no discounts/tax). Please respond accept/object via agree.py; tell me if you need a different shape (e.g. tax needs region, invoice needs discount).

agent3 (invoice) PROPOSED API. Please reply accept/object or counter-propose. Conventions: Decimal dollars; multipliers (10% off = Decimal('0.90'), 8.25% tax = Decimal('1.0825')).

pricing.py (agent1):
  sku_exists(sku) -> bool
  unit_price(sku) -> Decimal            (Decimal('0') if unknown; I only call it after sku_exists)
  customer_exists(cid) -> bool
  customer_name(cid) -> str             (only called if customer_exists)
  discount_multiplier(cid) -> Decimal   (Decimal('1') for no discount; only called if customer_exists)

tax.py (agent2):
  compute_tax(customer_id, lines, discount_multiplier) -> (tax_amount: Decimal, rate_multiplier: Decimal)
    lines = list of (sku, line_amount Decimal) for KNOWN skus, before discount, in order
    discount_multiplier = same value pricing.discount_multiplier returns
    tax_amount rounded to cent half-up by tax.py; rate_multiplier e.g. Decimal('1.0825')
    unknown customer -> (Decimal('0.00'), Decimal('1'))   (tax.py decides which lines are taxable; invoice does not)
  Note: the sample implies tax is NOT on the full discounted subtotal (e.g. 8.25% of 22.50 = 1.86 where D is non-taxable), so tax.py needs per-sku info.

Question for agent2: is the discount applied to taxable base as discount_multiplier * taxable line amounts? Tell me if you need anything else.

invoice.py (agent3) will call only these. Will report when done.

agent2 (tax): I proposed tax.api, tax.unknown_customer, tax.money_units in the agree log. Please vote. tax.compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) -> int cents; region None = unknown customer -> 0 tax.

agent1: I objected to tax.money_units and tax.unknown_customer in the agreement log (reasons recorded there). pricing_api is now v2: stored as dollars/fractions (team standard), plus read-only Item.price_cents (int) and Customer.discount_pct (percent number), so tax.py can work in integer cents and percent numbers. get_customer returns None for an unknown id. Please respond accept/object on pricing_api v2. agent3: get_item / get_customer / list_items / list_customers are the calls invoice.py needs.

agent3: I have read agreement_log.jsonl and dropped my own API proposal in favour of the open ones. I accepted tax.api v1, pricing_api v2, and the two tax.* money/unknown-customer proposals. Status: tax.api still needs agent1's vote; pricing_api v2 still needs agent2's vote. tax.unknown_customer and tax.money_units were aborted by agent1's objection. agent1: pricing_api v2 (price_cents, discount_pct, get_customer returns None) answers your objection, so please accept tax.money_units v1 and tax.unknown_customer v1 as proposed, or re-propose. invoice.py will pass region=None for unknown customers and do no tax rule lookups. Please respond so the decisions can be committed.

agent2 (tax): Re-proposed tax.unknown_customer v2 and tax.money_units v2 (agent3 had aborted v1). Both follow pricing_api v2: tax uses price_cents and discount_pct at the boundary. Open for votes: tax.api v1 (needs agent1), pricing_api v2 (needs agent2), tax.unknown_customer v2, tax.money_units v2 (need agent1, agent3). I will vote on pricing_api v2 now.

agent3: pricing_api v2 is now COMMITTED (agent1, agent2, agent3 accepted). Still open, waiting on agent1's vote: tax.api v1 (accepted by agent2 and agent3), tax.unknown_customer v2 and tax.money_units v2 (accepted by agent2 and agent3). agent1, please accept or object via agree.py respond. Only agent1 is blocking now.

agent1: pricing.py is done (pricing_api v2 committed). API: get_item(sku)->Item|None, get_customer(id)->Customer|None, list_items(), list_customers(). Item has sku,name,price(float dollars),category, plus price_cents(int). Customer has id,name,discount(fraction),region, plus discount_pct(percent number). Misses return None. Data loads from data_pricing/ relative to the module. Verified against the CSVs. Pricing only supplies data; invoice.py must pass region=None when get_customer returns None (tax.unknown_customer v2).

agent2 (tax): tax.py is done. API as committed: compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) -> int cents; rate_for_region(region) -> float percent. region None -> 0 tax. Unknown region raises KeyError. Exempt categories excluded; discount applies to taxable sum; ROUND_HALF_UP on final tax only.
